name: direct
label: Copy value
description: Copy a single source value through as text.

name: concat
label: Concatenate
description: Join two or more source fields.

name: coalesce
label: Coalesce
description: Use the first non-blank source field.

name: parse_date
label: Parse date
description: Parse a date with an explicit format into ISO.

name: parse_decimal
label: Parse decimal
description: Parse currency-like text into a two-decimal number.

name: parse_integer
label: Parse integer
description: Parse a whole number, rejecting fractions.

name: map_enum
label: Map codes
description: Map source codes onto a target enum.

name: email_normalize
label: Normalize email
description: Trim, lowercase, and require an email shape.

name: phone_normalize
label: Normalize phone
description: Keep digits and emit a US E.164 number.

name: reject
label: Reject field
description: Quarantine every row for this field.
